column2: Little child with great power... Whatever you may say, I cannot give you this stone.
Sonne! Mond! Stern! Kill her!
Stop!
You...
You're the one from that time...
Don't get in my way...
Why are you doing this? Tell me why...
Shut up... ...Next time I come, I'm taking the Demon Stone for sure.
Holy Mother! Are you hurt?
I'm all right... Thank you for saving me. I've worried you...
But tell me, why did you come all the way to the Forest of the Holy Mother?
I had a feeling that something bad was going to happen to the Reyforia Forest.
Monsters controlled by the Empire appearing in the Forest of Shadows... So I wanted to see you, Holy Mother.
I had a feeling that something bad was going to happen to the Reyforia Forest. So I wanted to see you, Holy Mother.
Holy Mother!
I already killed her.
You... Why are you doing this?
Answer me!!
Wait!!
Holy Mother, hold on!
Ah, the precious stone has been taken... Cecia... my power is no longer...
No... Holy Mother...
Cecia... child chosen by the angel... will you succeed me...?
Huh?
I understand that you hesitate to take on such a great responsibility...
But the Holy Mother's power will surely help you as you serve the angel... I'm sure of it...
Holy Mother... I'm so sorry... Just a little... Please give me just a little time.
Very well... I understand... I shall perform the ritual, so set your heart in order before then.
Yes... I understand.
Now I can make Mom well again...
You... What have you done...
Please, hold on!
Ah... the Demon Stone has been taken.
They mean to revive the Heavenly Dragon. Once all the Demon Stones are gathered, their ambition will be fulfilled...
If that happens, the world will be destroyed.
Child chosen by the angel... please, protect the world...
No... How could this happen...
Are you ready, Cecia?
Yes.
Then, your hand...
Has it reached you...?
Yes... It's all within me... I have truly received it.
I see... I'm glad... Then I shall go on ahead... Child blessed by the angel...
Holy Mother...
Ion's Mother
Bed
That boy...
He hasn't noticed us...
Angel, let's follow him.
Mom, I'm home.
I brought food from the village...
I'm sure that lady will come soon and make you well, Mom...
Because me and Stern and the others found the stone she promised.
You'll get well for sure... Don't worry... Oh, right, you need water. I'll go get some.
I have to... get the Demon Stone back!
...She's already dead.
That boy... he was talking to his dead mother...
Get away from my mom!!
You! You came to take back the Demon Stone!
I'll never give it back... With this, the lady who gave me power will make my mom well again...
Your mother has already passed away...
It may hurt, but listen to me...
No one can bring the dead back to life...
Shut up! Don't get in my way!
Sonne! Mond! Stern! Get her!
Stop fighting now...
Shut up...
I understand your sorrow...
But deep down, you must know too...
That your mother isn't coming back...
Shut up... shut up...
Come, let's lay your mother to rest in peace...
...Okay.
From now on, I'm sure your mother will watch over you from heaven...
Okay.
I'm sorry, I never asked your name...
What is it?
Ion... Ion Azbard.
Ion... That's a nice name. From now on...
I've come for the Demon Stone. Ion!
Hm? Who are you?
You... You were the one using Ion...
That aura... the angel's hero, is it?
Deceiving such a little boy... How cruel...
A deal is a deal. I'll keep my promise.
Now, Ion, I'll make your mother well again.
You don't believe me... Fine, look...
Mom?!
It's your precious mother, Ion.
...No. That's not Mom... I knew it... Mom's... already gone...
Aaagh!!
Ion!
I'll be taking the Demon Stone.
Wait!!
Go on and play with the child, hero of the angel. Ha ha ha ha ha.
...Big sister...
Tell me... your name, big sister...
It's Cecia!
Big sister Cecia...
Don't talk anymore...
I'm sorry, big sister Cecia...
I'm... going to go see Mom now...
Ion...
A deal is a deal. I'll keep my promise. Now, Ion, I'll make your mother well again.
...I guess I'm... going to go see Mom now...
Ravenruft
Ravenruft
Vastir, you have changed a great deal...
To call me by that name...
Have you forgotten me?
No... I have not forgotten. You are Diana.
Vastir... you were a strong man with true courage...
Why... are you like this now...
The man of that name died hundreds of years ago...
Defying the great dragon's blood, in disgrace.
The one here now is Ravenruft, king of the dead, master of darkness.
